Overview

Limerick is a city in Limerick with a population of 94,000. A historic city on the River Shannon, known for its medieval King John’s Castle, the Hunt Museum, and a growing technology and pharmaceutical sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
